reason: My POS is $40 and the paper and notebook work fine. Why pay $49 for something new, even with a 60-day trial? The bank terminal is already paid for and my techs know it.
objection: I pay $40 now, so $49 is more, and the savings are only a promise. Learning a new system on a busy Saturday scares me, and I have no idea if the other salons really like it.
would_change_my_mind: Another Vietnamese owner I know and trust from the Facebook group tells me it saved them real money. Or the price is at or under $40 with no card fee surprises.
